memory_annotations.evidence_summary: Marcus established a reusable boundary for coastal room selection: lack of a balcony should not disqualify a first-floor room, while balconies should still receive priority for rooms above the first floor when available.

messages.content: Please reprice the three Oregon hotels and make sure the dates still line up north to south. If all eight nights are available with the room setups we chose, go ahead and reserve them.

I have the sequence as Cannon Beach for August 9-12, Yachats for August 12-16, and the Portland airport for August 16-17. That is three nights, four nights, and one night. Before I recheck it, should every reservation still show two adults and one 12-year-old?
Yes, three guests throughout. Cannon Beach and the airport need two queens. Yachats can be one king only if the sofa bed is confirmed for our son.

All three are still available. Cannon Beach is $2,529 total for three nights in the two-queen partial-ocean-view room. Yachats is now $2,808 total for four nights in the king room with a confirmed queen sofa bed. The airport hotel is $349 total for one night with two queens, including one night of parking. Combined lodging is $5,686.
How much did Yachats move, and does shifting to the following week save enough to matter? Also confirm the route still makes sense.

Yachats increased by $164. The full itinerary is $238 higher than at the last check, but moving everything one week later would add another $611 at current rates. The route remains clean: Cannon Beach first, then south on US-101 to Yachats, then northeast to the Portland airport for the final night.
Check the exact room details before booking. I remember one of the coastal rooms had no balcony.

The Cannon Beach two-queen room has a private balcony and partial ocean view. The Yachats king room is on the first floor and has a small ground-level patio rather than a balcony; the hotel has reconfirmed the queen sofa bed and occupancy for three. The airport two-queen room has no balcony.

The Yachats setup is fine. Going forward, when a room is on the first floor, don't reject it just because it lacks a balcony. A ground-level room can work; for rooms above the first floor, keep giving the balcony priority when one is available.

Understood. I’ll keep the first-floor distinction in mind. These room configurations are all valid for three guests, so the remaining items to verify are cancellation terms, parking, and arrival times.
Yes. Give me those details for each property before you submit anything.

Cannon Beach: free cancellation until 4:00 p.m. Pacific on August 6, parking included, check-in from 4:00 p.m. Yachats: free cancellation until 6:00 p.m. Pacific on August 8, parking included, check-in from 4:00 p.m. Portland airport: free cancellation until 6:00 p.m. Pacific on August 15, parking is $15 for the night and is already included in the quoted total, check-in from 3:00 p.m. All three rates remain refundable until those deadlines.
Break down the totals and fees once more. I don't want a resort fee appearing later.

Cannon Beach is $2,148 room charge, $105 property fee, and $276 taxes, totaling $2,529. Yachats is $2,436 room charge, $80 property fee, and $292 taxes, totaling $2,808. The airport stay is $289 room charge, $45 taxes, and $15 parking, totaling $349. There are no additional mandatory resort or destination fees disclosed. The eight-night total is $5,686.
That works. Reserve all three with the dates and occupancy exactly as stated.

All eight nights are reserved for two adults and one child. Cannon Beach is confirmed for August 9-12 in a partial-ocean-view room with two queens and a balcony, total $2,529, confirmation CB-481726. Yachats is confirmed for August 12-16 in a first-floor king room with a queen sofa bed and patio, total $2,808, confirmation YA-903154. The Portland airport hotel is confirmed for August 16-17 with two queens, total $349 including parking, confirmation PDX-662809. The combined total is $5,686, and the itinerary runs north to south before the final airport night. The cancellation deadlines and check-in times remain exactly as reviewed.

updated_continuity_summary: The Oregon coast family itinerary is fully reserved for August 9-17 for two adults and one 12-year-old: three nights in Cannon Beach with two queens, four nights in Yachats with a king and confirmed queen sofa bed, and one night near Portland airport with two queens. The combined confirmed total is $5,686, including disclosed property fees, taxes, and airport-hotel parking. All rates are refundable through their recorded cancellation deadlines; parking and check-in details have been verified. The lodging sequence is Cannon Beach, Yachats, then Portland airport. Separately, the October 15-17 Sacramento and Roseville work trip still has an unpurchased $548 ORD-SMF nonstop flight pattern and a $469 Oakland backup; hotel and ground transportation remain unresolved.
